title.original: PipelineRL: Faster On-policy Reinforcement Learning for Long Sequence Generation
title.zh: PipelineRL：面向长序列生成的高速同策略强化学习
title.en: PipelineRL: Faster On-policy Reinforcement Learning for Long Sequence Generation

inclusion_reason.zh: PipelineRL 通过生成—训练并行、飞行中权重更新和版本追踪提供可复用的同策略长序列 RL 执行管线。
inclusion_reason.en: PipelineRL provides a reusable on-policy long-sequence RL pipeline through concurrent generation and training, in-flight weight updates, and version tracking.

abstract.zh: PipelineRL 并发执行长序列生成与模型训练，并在生成尚未结束时向推理引擎增量推送新权重，以兼顾加速器利用率和轨迹同策略新鲜度。
abstract.en: PipelineRL runs long-sequence generation concurrently with model training and pushes updated weights into the generation engine in flight, balancing accelerator utilization with on-policy trajectory freshness.

problem.zh: 完全同步 RL 会让训练等待慢轨迹，普通异步化虽提高利用率，却产生陈旧的离策略数据并损害常用策略优化算法。
problem.en: Fully synchronous RL waits for slow trajectories, while ordinary asynchrony improves utilization at the cost of stale off-policy data that can undermine policy optimization.

approach.zh: 系统让生成和训练形成流水线，并设计飞行中权重更新，在单条 token 序列生成期间以最小中断刷新推理模型。
approach.en: The system pipelines generation with training and introduces in-flight weight updates that refresh the inference model during token-sequence production with minimal interruption.

system_design.zh: 生成引擎持续产出轨迹，训练器消费已完成数据并更新策略，权重通道把新参数分片推送到仍在服务的生成实例，版本追踪记录每段轨迹的策略新鲜度。
system_design.en: Generation engines stream trajectories, the trainer consumes completed data and updates the policy, a weight channel pushes new parameter shards to live engines, and version tracking records trajectory freshness.

key_results.zh: 长文本推理实验显示，该流水线比常规 RL 基线更快学习，同时保持训练数据高度接近当前策略。
key_results.en: Long-form reasoning experiments show faster learning than conventional RL baselines while keeping generated data close to the current policy.

limitations.zh: 实验集中于大规模同构 GPU 和长序列任务；飞行中更新的一致性、网络压力以及对不同 RL 算法的偏差影响仍需评估。
limitations.en: Experiments focus on large homogeneous GPUs and long sequences; consistency during in-flight updates, network pressure, and bias under other RL algorithms require further study.

notes.zh: 已填模型、工作负载、硬件、基线和指标均来自官方 arXiv 摘要或 comment；摘要未披露的表格明细、硬件拓扑与集群配置仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Populated models, workloads, hardware, baselines, and metrics come from the official arXiv abstract or comment; undisclosed table details, hardware topology, and cluster configuration still require full-text audit.
